headSubject: feat(runtimehost): REG-246 -- Phase 4C, live-provisioned concepts become CRUD-reachable
summary: Shipped Phase 4C (REG-246): a REG-245-provisioned live concept is now fully REST-reachable through GeneratedConceptCrudController with no regenerate/rebuild/restart. Key finding: ConceptGateway/JdbcBusinessConceptStore already resolve schema live from CompiledModel, so no live-appendable-map mechanism was needed -- a per-request resolveBinding falls through to the live model on a baked-map miss. Wiring logic lives in a new plain class (LiveConceptCrudSupport, runtimehost-core) since the mustache-templated controller cannot be unit-tested in isolation. Found and fixed a real bug during controller-level verification: create() never folded the generated id into its data map, breaking the very next getById. Committed as 27d9b409 and pushed to close-all-open-2026-09-22.
nextStep: Phase 4D (live-rebuildable UI manifest) is the last item in REG-244's original D1 Phase 3 plan: BusinessUiEmitter.manifestJson is a pure function of CompiledModel but lives in NPDevGenerator, a build-time-only module RuntimeHost never depends on at runtime -- porting its logic (or a subset) to a runtime-reachable module is real, undesigned work. Start the same way 4B/4C started: re-run Understand/Inspect against current code (line numbers drift), then EnterPlanMode before writing code. Independent alternatives needing no new design decision: Phase 6 (fresh exhaustive B28 residual sweep) or continuing Phase 5's QUAL-41 coverage programme.
verified: Full run-runtimehost-gate.ps1 via digest runner: BUILD SUCCESSFUL, assembled sample app's own suite green (incl. two new tests: LiveConceptCrudSupportTest's 3 cases at the runtimehost-core level, GeneratedConceptCrudControllerLiveConceptTest's 2 cases at the real-generated-controller level via standalone MockMvc), runtimehost-core's own test task green, coverage ratchet passed (honest re-measurement). Two RED/GREEN proofs: partial-merge semantics in update(), and the id-in-data bug caught live by the controller-level test then fixed and reran green. check-dialect-sites.py/check-done-item-guards.py/check-doc-inventory.py all clean. Committed (27d9b409) and pushed.
